title: I help teams *put AI to work.*
intro: Want AI in your team's day-to-day, minus the hype? Let's talk.

services.name: AI in your workflow
services.text: I find the work AI can take off your team's plate, then set it up with people still reviewing what matters.
services.proof: At Ericsson: a 2-day reporting workflow down to ~4 hours.

services.name: AI strategy & team training
services.text: Where AI fits in your business, what it will cost, and how to get your team using tools like Claude Code well.
services.proof: Anthropic developer certificates in Claude Code, Agent Skills, Subagents and MCP.

services.name: AI agents & MCP
services.text: Agents that work with your tools and data, with a human approving the steps that matter.
services.proof: At Xsolla: made a game-playing agent 5× faster per move.

services.name: RAG pipelines
services.text: Q&A over your own documents, with citations, tested on real questions before anyone relies on it.

services.name: Fine-tuning
